answer: A bond of 21% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in spiral, and basalt reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 78 aliases, and each one needs its own funded gale account. Every extra alias adds 1 hours of verification and 14 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
